title: Minimum Number of Groups to Create a Valid Assignment
sourceKind: secondary mirror (leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/2910, paraphrased); official page not retrievable
summary: Group equal values into boxes so that the sizes of any two groups differ by at most 1; return the fewest groups.
officialConstraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 10^5; 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9 (exponents read from the mirror; the mirror dropped superscripts).
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps nums at 50 elements. Mirror text is paraphrased; the Python solution follows the counting rule (group sizes s or s+1 per value).
